instruction_display.section_instructions: Display section-specific instructions on each section page
instruction_display.time_tracking: Real-time exam timer and submission status

section_navigation.linear_flow: Students complete sections in order (A → B → C → D → E)
section_navigation.review_before_submit: Review all responses before final submission

marking_workflow.stage_2: Queue sections B-E for manual grading
marking_workflow.stage_4: Final marks calculation and result compilation

assessment_design: Progressive difficulty: Sections A→B (factual) → C→D (conceptual) → E (analytical)
Equal chapter emphasis: 50-50 or 55-45 split between Nutrition in Plants and Animals
Question types test multiple competencies: recall, application, analysis, synthesis
question_paper_characteristics: All 4 papers (A-D) follow identical structure but test different content areas
4 different MCQ sets reduce cheating and enable parallel testing
Each paper covers same concepts at different difficulty levels within same total marks
Assertion-Reason format in Q4 tests deeper understanding beyond simple recall
blueprint_implications: 40% of marks require application of concepts
20% of marks demand analysis and critical thinking
Clear distribution helps maintain question paper quality and balance
